title: amaranthus polygonoides subsp. berlandieri
intro: Amaranthus polygonoides subsp. berlandieri, commonly known as Mexican grain amaranth, is a plant species within the Amaranthaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its edible seeds, which are rich in nutrients, including protein, fiber, and minerals, providing various health benefits such as lowering cholesterol levels and aiding in weight management. The therapeutic actions of Mexican grain amaranth include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include squalene, unsolic acid, and other triterpenoid compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and uses.
